{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Confirm the revenue column has commas and needs parsing
df['revenue_clean'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for any non-numeric or malformed values
print("Any non-numeric revenue values after cleaning?", df['revenue_clean'].isna().any())

# Check for the internal test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
print("Number of rows with revenue = 999999.99:", (df['revenue_clean'] == 999999.99).sum())

# Check for refunded orders
print("Number of refunded orders:", (df['status'] == 'refunded').sum())

# Now, calculate total revenue from completed orders, excluding internal test orders
# Filter: status == 'completed' and revenue != 999999.99
completed_filtered = df[(df['status'] == 'completed') & (df['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99)]
total_revenue = completed_filtered['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the result
print(f"Total revenue from completed orders (excluding internal test orders): {total_revenue}")"}
